events.summary: Aero holsters the blaster pistol. His left hand is free; the saber stays lit in his right.

details.text:
You bring the pistol down and seat it in the holster. It goes home with a small, final click.

Your left hand comes away empty. In your right the blade is still lit, its hum the only steady sound on the deck, its indigo light lying across the plating and the dark shell of the remote.

The remote has not moved. Five feet off, a black-rimmed hole in its housing, a thread of smoke. Within reach of the hand you just freed.

The sim holds the reset.

events.summary: Scene: the sim deck; blaster holstered, left hand free, saber lit in the right; the disabled remote within reach, its damage unproven; the sim holding the reset.
